title: Denmark’s Postal Service Is About to Stop Delivering Physical Letters After 400 Years
summary:
丹麦街头那些鲜艳醒目的红色邮筒，一直是当地一道标志性风景，备受游客和居民喜爱。然而，随着丹麦国有邮政服务机构计划终止国内信件投递业务，这些色彩明丽的邮筒正逐渐从街角消失。12月30日，PostNord邮政公司将在丹麦投递最后一封信件。这家公司成立于2009年，由瑞典与丹麦邮政合并而成，属国有企业，未来在丹麦将继续提供包裹配送服务。而瑞典境内的信件投递业务则不受影响，照常运行。

来源：史密森尼；作者：Sarah Kuta；原文发布时间：2025-12-26 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: Denmark’s cheery, bright red mailboxes are an iconic sight, beloved by visitors and residents alike. Now, however, the colorful vessels are disappearing from street corners as the state-run Danish postal service prepares to end its letter delivery service in the country. On December 30, PostNord will deliver its last letter in Denmark. The government-owned company, which formed in 2009 as a merger between the Swedish and Danish postal services, will continue distributing packages in Denmark. Letter delivery in Sweden will also continue.
paragraphs.contentZh: 丹麦街头那些鲜艳醒目的红色邮筒，一直是当地一道标志性风景，备受游客和居民喜爱。然而，随着丹麦国有邮政服务机构计划终止国内信件投递业务，这些色彩明丽的邮筒正逐渐从街角消失。12月30日，PostNord邮政公司将在丹麦投递最后一封信件。这家公司成立于2009年，由瑞典与丹麦邮政合并而成，属国有企业，未来在丹麦将继续提供包裹配送服务。而瑞典境内的信件投递业务则不受影响，照常运行。

paragraphs.contentEn: “We have been the Danes’ postal service for 400 years, and therefore it is a difficult decision to put a bow on that part of our story,” says Kim Pedersen, CEO for PostNord Denmark in a statement, per a translation by the Associated Press. “The Danes have become more and more digital, which means that there are very few letters left for us to handle today, and the downturn continues so clearly that the market for letters is no longer profitable.”
paragraphs.contentZh: PostNord丹麦公司首席执行官金·彼得森在一份声明中表示（引自美联社译文）：“400年来，我们一直是丹麦人的邮政服务机构，因此，为这段历史画上句号是一个艰难的决定。随着丹麦社会日益数字化，如今需要我们处理的信件已所剩无几，而且下滑趋势仍在持续，信件投递业务已明显不具备盈利空间。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Letter-writers in Denmark will still be able to send mail via the delivery company Dao, per the Guardian’s Miranda Bryant. But they’ll either have to take their post to a Dao shop directly, or pay a fee to have their mail collected. Dao already operates in Denmark but plans to expand its footprint next year, expecting to go from 30 million to 80 million letters.
paragraphs.contentZh: 据《卫报》记者米兰达·布莱恩特报道，丹麦仍有寄信需求的民众可以通过递送公司Dao寄送信件。但寄件人需要自行将信件送至Dao的线下网点，或是支付费用预约上门收件。Dao目前已在丹麦运营，并计划于明年扩大服务网络，其信件处理量预计将从3000万封增至8000万封。

paragraphs.contentEn: The Danish postal service has been delivering letters in Denmark since Christian IV established it in 1624. However, demand for letter delivery has plummeted amid increasing digitalization. Denmark has a national digital identification system, for instance, and all official communications are sent digitally. The number of letters sent in Denmark has decreased by more than 90 percent since 2000, falling from more than 1.4 billion to less than 200 million, according to statistics provided by PostNord. In 2024 alone, letter delivery declined by more than 30 percent compared to 2023. PostNord blames that drop on legislation that caused the price of postage to skyrocket to roughly $4.50 per letter, per the Economist.
paragraphs.contentZh: 丹麦邮政自1624年由克里斯蒂安四世创立以来，便一直承担着国内信件投递的业务。然而，随着数字化程度不断加深，信件投递需求大幅下滑。例如，丹麦已建立全国性数字身份系统，所有官方通信均已实现数字化。据PostNord提供的统计数据，自2000年以来，丹麦的信件寄送量已减少90%以上，从超过14亿封降至不足2亿封。仅在2024年，信件投递量就较2023年下降了30%以上。《经济学人》报道称，PostNord将这一降幅归咎于一项立法，该立法导致每封信的邮资飙升至约4.5美元。

paragraphs.contentEn: “Danes hardly receive any letters anymore,” Pedersen tells BBC News’ Adrienne Murray. “They’re receiving one letter a month on average. It’s not a lot.” “On the contrary,” he adds, “Danes love to shop online. Global e-commerce is growing significantly, and we are moving with it.” Since first announcing the change in March, PostNord has been dismantling the 1,500 red mailboxes located throughout the country. It has also laid off 1,500 of its 4,600 employees. Mailboxes in good condition are being sold for around $315, while those in poorer condition are going for around $236. So far, 1,000 of the mailboxes have been sold, with another 200 set to be auctioned at the start of the new year, per the Guardian.
paragraphs.contentZh: 彼得森在接受BBC新闻记者阿德里安·默里采访时表示：“丹麦人现在已经收不到什么信件了。平均每人每月仅有一封，数量非常有限。”但他补充道：“相反，丹麦人对网购的热情很高。全球电子商务正在蓬勃发展，我们也在顺应这一趋势作出调整。”自今年3月首次宣布此项变革以来，PostNord已经开始逐步拆除分布在全国各地的1500个红色邮筒，并裁减了4600名员工中的1500人。状况良好的邮筒目前单只售价约为315美元，品相较差的约为236美元。据《卫报》报道，截至目前，已有1000个邮筒售出，另有200个定于明年年初拍卖。

paragraphs.contentEn: Denmark may be the first European country to end state-run letter delivery—but it likely won’t be the last. Postal services in other countries around the world are also struggling, including those in Greece, Canada and the United States, reports the Economist. “Denmark is a canary in the coal mine,” Marvin Ryder, a market scholar at McMaster University in Canada, tells CBC News’ Mark Gollom.
paragraphs.contentZh: 丹麦或将成为欧洲首个终止国有信件投递业务的国家——但这很可能不是最后一个。《经济学人》报道称，包括希腊、加拿大和美国在内的全球多国邮政服务，同样深陷困境。加拿大麦克马斯特大学的市场学者马文·莱德在接受CBC新闻记者马克·戈洛姆采访时表示：“丹麦就像那只矿井里的金丝雀。”
